rootCause: A per-request sqlite_home creates a fresh state database; CLI 0.162.0 backfills existing CODEX_HOME rollouts before starting the requested turn, even with --ephemeral. The host history was large enough to exceed both fixture deadlines.

evidence.windowsEnvironmentVariant: Adding Windows standard environment variables did not fix startup.

fix.change: Remove sqlite_home override; retain ephemeral execution, no history persistence, isolated request files, disabled host instructions and tool suppression.

cleanup: Removal of temporary diagnostic database copies was rejected by automatic approval review as blocked by policy. Copies remain in this private evidence directory and are not committed or shared.
